text:
olivia: FYI — between 01:40-02:05 UTC a vendor enrichment webhook started returning 504s. ~387 web leads were routed to the manual fallback queue because the HS workflow gate checks `has_enrichment = true`. Spotted by Slack alert. @ben @maria can we triage?

ben: Thanks, olivia. Can you drop the error snippet? Also is this across all sources or only the public website form?

olivia: Snippet: ```POST /vendor/enrich 504 at 2026-03-22T01:48:12Z payload={"vid":"C-321"} latency=30007ms``` Only `source=web` so far.

maria: If enrichment stalls the HS workflow falls back to owner = `manual-triage`, which SDRs don't monitor. That's the worst path.

raj: Short-term mitigations proposal: 1) Increase claim_window from 5m -> 12m for intake workspace overnight 2) Add a temporary HS branch: if `lead_score >= 75` and `source == 'web'` then route to RR without enrichment 3) Kick off an automated backfill to assign the fallback queue. Which do we run now?

ben: Run (3) + (1). Backfill first so reps get immediate load. I'll keep (2) as a toggleed patch we can flip if backfill lags.

ops-bot: ops-bot: change request: set `claim_window_seconds=720` for workspace `marketing-intake` during 00:00-06:00 UTC. Pending approval.

maria: Approve. Also I can implement the HS permissive branch for 24h and tag assignments with `temp_enrich_override=true` so we can filter later.

olivia: Good — add an audit event on each temp assignment. Also add a metric for `fallback_queue_rate` so we don't miss these next time.

leadflow-bot: leadflow-bot: queued backfill (job=bf-20260322-02) dry-run mode. Query: `source=web AND created_at between 2026-03-22T01:30:00Z and 2026-03-22T02:10:00Z AND owner='manual-triage'` Estimated matches 387.

ben: Running dry-run: `python scripts/backfill_contacts.py --job bf-20260322-02 --dry-run`

leadflow-bot: leadflow-bot: dry-run complete. 387 matches. Proceed? (yes/no)

ben: Proceeding. Real run launched.

leadflow-bot: leadflow-bot: backfill bf-20260322-02 completed. Reassigned 374 contacts, 13 transient failures (will retry). Logs at s3://redwood-backfills/bf-20260322-02/log.txt

olivia: Nice work. Keep claim_window extension in place for tonight and we'll roll back tomorrow AM if metrics look good.

raj: I'll add a Prometheus alert: `expr: sum(rate(enrichment_failures[5m])) / sum(rate(enrichment_requests[5m])) > 0.005` -> route to paging rule `pd_enrichment_degen`. Also creating a low-priority PD runbook for Marketing on-call.

maria: Quick SF note: if HubSpot sync pushed owner='manual-triage' to Salesforce before backfill, we created a bunch of unowned leads in SF. I'll run a reconcile: `SELECT Id FROM Lead WHERE OwnerId = 'manual-triage' AND CreatedDate >= 2026-03-22` and then map backfill ID -> SF owner. I'll post results here.

ben: Runbook steps I used: 1) verify webhook error rate 2) flip `claim_window` 3) run backfill dry-run -> real 4) tag temp assignments 5) monitor PD alert & fallback rate. Adding to handshake doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/marketing/inbound-sla.md (draft).

olivia: Two follow-ups: 1) add retry/backoff to enrichment webhook client (3 retries, exponential backoff) 2) vendor SLA review — ping vendor ops for 99.9% success during business hours.

ops-bot: ops-bot: claim_window applied.

maria: Reconcile complete at 09:45 UTC: 13 leads still unassigned in SF due to SF API transient errors; created a ticket for async retry. All others reconciled to RR owners. Posting CSV to s3://redwood-reconciles/2026-03-22-09-45.csv

olivia: Thanks. Let's keep permissive HS branch enabled only if fallback rate > 0.3% in a 15m window. raj, can you add that condition to the toggle?

raj: Yep, will gate toggle with `fallback_rate > 0.003` over 15m. Also adding a Grafana panel to the marketing dashboard.

ben: Final note: we'll schedule a 1-hr retro tomorrow to decide longer term: options include persistent enrichment retries, local caching of enrichment results, and moving certain fields into the form so RR gating doesn't rely on the vendor for critical routing.

olivia: Great — thanks team. Sending a one-line blurb to SDR leads: @maria @nate — alert and backfill completed, monitoring. :thumbsup:
